results.title: Every actionable refusal says what to do instead
results.evidence: 28 actionable refusal code(s) of 773 raise sites carry an explicitly empty remediation, so a caller who did something they could have done differently is told what and not what instead: already_decided, already_recorded, already_registered, already_revoked, approval_closed, bad_digest, bad_signature, campaign_closed, channel_not_built, different_version, discovery_incomplete, duplicate_capability
